title: Anna's Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. There is a big park near her house. She goes to the park with her dog every morning. There is also a library next to the park.

After school, Anna goes to the library. She reads books there with her friend Tom. Then they buy bread at the bakery across the street. The bakery is open until six.

questions.text: Where do Anna and Tom buy bread?
How does Anna probably feel about the park?
Why do Anna and Tom probably go to the library together?

vocabulary.definition: a place where people can borrow books
a shop where bread and cakes are made and sold
a public place with grass and trees

paragraph_translations: Anna mieszka w małym mieście. Obok jej domu jest duży park. Każdego ranka chodzi do parku ze swoim psem. Obok parku jest też biblioteka.
Po szkole Anna idzie do biblioteki. Czyta tam książki ze swoim przyjacielem Tomem. Potem kupują chleb w piekarni po drugiej stronie ulicy. Piekarnia jest otwarta do szóstej.
